subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails: true` be suppressed globally, or should the current cron, heartbeat, timeout, and full-verbose detail warning paths remain visible?
rationale: Current source and tests encode visible detail paths, while the linked issue and PR request suppress-all behavior; automation cannot safely choose that user-visible policy.

options.title: Preserve Detail Contexts
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, timeout, and full-verbose exec details visible while fixing only unintended chat-noise paths, with focused tests.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Move exec-like suppression ahead of mutating handling and update tests and proof to show the intentionally hidden detail cases.

options.title: Reject The Direction
options.body: If visible detail warnings are the desired contract, close the linked issue and this PR with that rationale.

recommendation.title: Preserve Detail Contexts
recommendation.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, timeout, and full-verbose exec details visible while fixing only unintended chat-noise paths, with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest shared-helper and Codex-runtime history among the likely owners for deciding the warning contract.
